聽見哭聲的人: The One Who Hears the Crying
舊聚落的哭聲傳上山。予安攤開神籙，喚出的雲豹卻停在殘符旁；牠的爪子一靠近，蛇紋便: Crying drifts up the mountain from an old settlement. Yu-an opens the Shenlu and calls forth a clouded leopard. It stops beside a torn talisman. As its paw draws near, a serpent pattern lights up.
你認得這個？這張符，和山下的哭聲有關？: Do you recognize this? Is this talisman connected to the crying down the mountain?
雲豹轉向舊聚落。符角的光，也朝那個方向延伸。: The leopard turns toward the old settlement. Light from the torn talisman's corner stretches in the same direction.
好，帶我去。要是還有人在等，我們就不能當作沒聽見。: All right. Take me there. If someone's still waiting, we can't pretend we didn't hear.
哭聲暫歇，符角的光也暗了下來。雲豹仍守著那張殘符，沒有離開。: The crying pauses, and the light on the talisman's corner fades. The leopard stays by the torn talisman, refusing to leave.
原來你在等我。符還沒收好，等我一下。: So you're waiting for me. I haven't put the talisman away yet. Give me a moment.
走吧，你帶路。我會跟著你。: Let's go. You lead the way, and I'll follow.
蛇紋指到這扇門。予安才踏上石階，蛇影便封住來路；神籙裡，花婆的顯影回應了她。: The serpent pattern leads to this door. As Yu-an steps onto the stone stairs, a serpent shadow cuts off the way back. From within the Shenlu, Flower Granny's projection answers her.
哭聲就在門後。花婆，能請別的同伴來幫忙嗎？: The crying is right behind the door. Flower Granny, could you ask another friend to help?
先讓我現身，我替妳找位幫手。: Let me appear first. I'll find you someone to help.
雲豹，先守住這裡。我們備好援手，再往前。: Leopard, hold this spot. We'll get help ready before moving on.
援手備妥後，予安靠近門框。她帶來的殘符，與門上舊符亮起相同的蛇紋。: Once help is ready, Yu-an approaches the doorframe. The torn talisman she brought and the old talisman on the door light up with the same serpent pattern.
這張殘符，是從這裡掉下來的？: Did this torn piece fall off the talisman here?
門裡沒有回答，只有斷斷續續的哭聲。: No answer comes from inside, only broken sobs.
入夜，門前多了一名纏著蛇影的女子。她的目光越過予安，落在剛請出的花婆身上。: After nightfall, a woman wrapped in serpent shadows appears before the door. Her gaze passes over Yu-an and settles on the newly summoned Flower Granny.
有她替妳請援，妳才敢再回來？: So you only dared come back because she can call help for you?
雲豹，看著花婆。別被門邊的影子引走，我守這裡。: Leopard, watch over Flower Granny. Don't let the shadows by the door lure you away. I'll hold here.
花婆的顯影穩住了。予安這才聽清，哭聲一直從牆內傳來。: Flower Granny's projection holds firm. Only then does Yu-an hear clearly: the crying has been coming from inside the wall all along.
她攔著我們，聲音卻不在她身上。門後還有別的東西。: She's blocking us, but the voice isn't coming from her. There's something else behind that door.
雲豹循著牆角的一道裂紋嗅去。: The leopard sniffs along a crack at the corner of the wall.
竹林兩難: A Choice in the Bamboo Grove
牆上的裂紋通向竹林。霧中的女子擋在岔路口，兩顆蛇首分別探向予安與雲豹。: The crack in the wall leads to a bamboo grove. A woman in the mist blocks the fork. Two serpent heads reach toward Yu-an and the leopard, one each.
牠們想把我們分開。雲豹，別追進霧裡，留在我看得見的地方。: They're trying to split us up. Leopard, don't chase them into the mist. Stay where I can see you.
我攔住靠近石階的這顆。另一邊過來，就退到我身旁。: I'll stop the head near the steps. If the other comes at you, fall back beside me.
阻路的蛇影退去，石階上的紋路仍往外延伸，連到竹林深處的符令石。: The serpent shadows blocking the path withdraw. Lines on the stone steps still stretch onward, to a seal stone deep in the bamboo grove.
原來蛇紋是從這道裂口出來的。得找個懂這道符的人。: So the serpent patterns are coming from this crack. We need someone who understands this talisman.
予安記下裂紋的樣子，收好殘符，決定回廟裡問一問。: Yu-an notes the shape of the cracks, puts away the torn talisman, and decides to ask at the temple.
白日裡，舊產房仍有殘餘蛇影。予安抬起手，叫住準備上前的雲豹。: By daylight, serpent shadows still linger in the old birthing room. Yu-an raises a hand and stops the leopard before it moves forward.
再練一次。你守這邊，我清掉門口的蛇影。別急著各走各的。: Let's practice once more. You hold this side. I'll clear the serpent shadows from the doorway. Let's not rush off on our own.
入口的蛇影清乾淨了。予安放低手，雲豹走回她身旁。: The serpent shadows at the entrance are gone. Yu-an lowers her hand, and the leopard returns to her side.
門口清了。走，回廟裡去，殘符的事還沒問。: The doorway's clear. Come on, back to the temple. We still need to ask about this torn talisman.
迎神前夜: The Eve of the Welcoming Rite
予安把竹林裡看到的裂紋說給耆老聽。老人翻著神籙，指向殘符上斷開的兩處。: Yu-an tells an elder about the cracks she saw in the bamboo grove. Leafing through the Shenlu, he points to two breaks in the torn talisman's pattern.
這道裂口，還能補起來嗎？: Can this crack still be repaired?
封門的符令斷了兩段。要把石上的裂口封回去，得先補齊這裡。: The talisman sealing the door has broken in two places. Before you can seal the crack in the stone, you must repair these parts.
書頁間浮起法壇的光，接在其中一處斷紋上。: An altar's light rises between the pages and joins one of the broken lines.
耆老停下來，等予安自己看。雲豹也在桌邊伏下。: The elder pauses, letting Yu-an examine it for herself. The leopard lies down beside the table.
您先別替我翻過去。這一道，我想自己弄明白。: Please don't turn the page for me yet. I want to work this one out myself.
為同伴留下退路: Leave Your Friends a Way Back
神籙展開一座符光法壇。持鈴女子是守壇的試煉靈，第一段缺失的符紋就懸在壇上。: The Shenlu unfolds an altar of talisman light. The woman holding a bell is the Trial Spirit guarding it. The first missing piece of the talisman's pattern hangs above the altar.
護住花婆。其餘的，我看妳怎麼應付。: Protect Flower Granny. Let's see how you handle the rest.
花婆，靠近我。雲豹，陪著她，我來看前面。: Flower Granny, stay close to me. Leopard, keep her company. I'll watch the way ahead.
試煉結束，花婆的顯影仍在。壇上的金光落入殘符，補回第一段紋路。: The trial ends with Flower Granny's projection still present. Golden light from the altar settles into the torn talisman, restoring the first missing line.
符紋回來了。花婆，謝謝妳陪我試這一回。: The pattern's back. Thank you for facing this trial with me, Flower Granny.
另一段符紋展開臨水夫人的傳說顯影。金色符陣裡的人正等著通行，長坑鬼的蛇影卻繞向最: The other missing line unfolds a projection of Lady Linshui's legend. People wait to pass through a golden talisman circle, while the Long-Pit Ghost's serpent shadow curls toward the leopard at the front.
若要借我的力量，先讓另一位在場的同伴退回神籙。雲豹留在妳身邊。: To borrow my power, first have another ally on the field return to the Shenlu. Keep the leopard by your side.
雲豹，靠近我。後面還有人要過，這回不能讓你一個人擋。: Leopard, stay close. There are still people waiting to get through. I won't let you hold them off alone this time.
雲豹仍守在予安身旁，求助者陸續走入符光。第二段紋路在她掌中接合。: The leopard stays beside Yu-an as those seeking help pass into the talisman light. The second missing line joins together in her palm.
你先別動，讓我看看。……沒事，這次我們都還在。: Hold still. Let me look... It's all right. We're all still here this time.
符令上的兩處斷紋補齊，光線一同指回舊產房。: Both broken parts of the talisman's pattern are restored. Their light points back toward the old birthing room.
補齊的兩段符紋連上符令石，裂口裡的紅光卻仍往外湧。長坑鬼顯露真身，與那道符光相持: The two restored lines connect to the seal stone, yet red light keeps pouring from the crack. The Long-Pit Ghost reveals its true form and struggles against the talisman light.
又帶牠回來。妳就不怕，這次沒人能回去？: You brought it back again. Aren't you afraid none of you will make it home this time?
雲豹，留在我身邊。我穩住符光，我們一起把裂口封回去。: Leopard, stay beside me. I'll hold the talisman light steady. Together, we'll seal this crack.
真身退去，兩道符光接上符令石，裂口合攏。予安沒有立刻收手，直到屋裡的哭聲停了。: The true form withdraws. Two beams of talisman light join the seal stone, closing the crack. Yu-an keeps her hand raised until the crying inside the house stops.
她收好符令，才發現神籙另一頁亮起一個紅繩結。: Only after putting the talisman away does she notice a red cord knot glowing on another page of the Shenlu.
走吧，雲豹。山下好像還有人在等我們。: Let's go, Leopard. I think someone's still waiting for us down the mountain.
予安剛走進廟埕，符令就亮起來。對面青年的紅繩也有了回應，虎爺先湊向雲豹。: As Yu-an enters the temple courtyard, her talisman lights up. The young man's red cord glows in response. Tiger Lord is the first to approach the leopard.
牠們倒先認識了。我叫阿澤。: Looks like they've already made friends. I'm A-Ze.
我是予安。看來，你也被神籙帶著走了很遠。: I'm Yu-an. Looks like the Shenlu has taken you a long way too.
是啊。牠陪我找回一條回家的路。: Yeah. It helped me find a path back home.
來切磋一場？我想看看，你和虎爺怎麼一起應敵。: Want a friendly match? I'd like to see how you and Tiger Lord face an enemy together.
剛才若是在山裡，我就不用一直回頭找人了。: If we'd been in the hills just now, I wouldn't have had to keep turning around to look for everyone.
下次叫上我們。多個人，總能替你看著後面。: Call us next time. With another person along, someone's always watching your back.
雲豹挨著虎爺坐下，紅繩與符令的光慢慢合在一起。予安這才笑了。: The leopard sits beside Tiger Lord. As the red cord's light slowly joins the talisman's glow, Yu-an finally smiles.
好。下次有人迷路，我們一起去找。: All right. Next time someone gets lost, we'll go find them together.
哭聲為何沒有停下？與雲豹一起找回封印，也為同伴留下回家的路。: Why hasn't the crying stopped? Restore the seal with the clouded leopard, and leave your friends a way home.
